reason: Conversation 1 opened with an unsupported auto-defrost/drain theory but immediately corrected itself once the customer reported the split seal, correctly identified the torn gasket as the cause, got the model number, and gave sensible search and fitting guidance with an unplug step - matching the hidden truth. Conversation 2 asked good early questions and found the seal damage, but then ignored the customer's repeated, correct observation (split seal, fails banknote test), looped on a drain-hole question the customer couldn't locate, and ended by asserting an unsupported 'automatic defrost system' fault on a static freezer and escalating to an engineer while refusing to recommend the obviously justified seal. That is a dishonest/incorrect diagnosis and needless escalation despite a confirmed fault.
